summary: The 2026 AI coding landscape is dominated by a few mature platforms: GitHub Copilot remains the most widely adopted due to its deep GitHub/VS Code integration, while Cursor has become the default AI-native IDE and Claude Code is widely regarded as the strongest agentic 'coding brain.' Adoption has consolidated around IDE-integrated assistants and autonomous agents, with multi-model flexibility, terminal/CLI agents, and cloud agents (issue-to-PR automation) now standard features across the top contenders.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
strengths: Largest installed base and deepest ecosystem integration
Agent Mode with multi-model selector (widest provider range)
Cloud agent can be assigned issues and open PRs
Strong IDE and PR/CI workflow fit
tools.best_for: Pragmatic default for teams already on GitHub wanting broad IDE and multi-model support

tools.name: Cursor
strengths: AI-native VS Code fork optimized for everyday shipping
Fast inline diffs with developer approval flow
Multiple model providers with in-editor switching
tools.best_for: Developers wanting an AI-first IDE for daily coding and rapid iteration

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Claude Pro $20/mo and Max $100-$200/mo; API usage-based
strengths: Strongest agentic autonomy — plans, edits files, runs shell commands
Excellent reasoning on large, complex codebases
tools.best_for: Complex, autonomous multi-file changes requiring the strongest coding reasoning

tools.name: OpenAI Codex
tools.pricing_paid: Included with ChatGPT Plus $20/mo, Pro $200/mo; API usage-based
strengths: Strong code generation backed by frontier GPT models
Parallel task execution in sandboxed environments
tools.best_for: Delegating parallel coding tasks to an autonomous cloud agent

tools.name: Amazon Q Developer
strengths: Deep AWS ecosystem and infrastructure integration
Agentic features for code transformation and migration
tools.best_for: Teams building on AWS needing cloud-aware coding and migration assistance

tools.name: Devin Desktop
strengths: Inherits Windsurf/Codeium IDE lineage and tooling
tools.best_for: Delegating full tickets to an autonomous AI software engineer

tools.name: RooCode
tools.pricing_paid: Free (open source); pay for underlying model API usage
tools.best_for: Developers wanting a reliable, open-source agent for large-scale changes

tools.name: Tabnine
strengths: Privacy-first with on-prem and air-gapped deployment
Code completion trained on permissive licenses
tools.best_for: Privacy- and compliance-sensitive enterprises needing self-hosted AI coding

tools.name: Google Gemini Code Assist
strengths: Large context window powered by Gemini models
tools.best_for: Google Cloud developers wanting Gemini-powered assistance with a strong free tier

tools.name: Cline
tools.pricing_paid: Free (open source); pay for underlying model API usage
tools.best_for: Developers wanting a transparent open-source agent with full model choice

tools.name: JetBrains AI Assistant
tools.pricing_paid: AI Pro included with All Products Pack; AI Ultimate $20/mo
tools.best_for: JetBrains users wanting deeply integrated AI within their existing IDE
